what_this_is: The vertices of every fault mesh on the survey run, read out of the evaluation scene the frames were rendered from. Wall coordinates: theta in radians, z in metres, and inset, how far toward the middle of the tank the vertex is drawn. outlines holds the rendered edge of every visible rust patch and of each of its islands, as closed rings. tank/truth.py projects these, so the answer key is the geometry that was rendered and not a description of it.
